# Section A: Structure Code
## 1. Walls \t a. Walls must surround the entirety of the room, excluding entry and exit points
\t b. The outermost wall of the station must be reinforced
\t c. If it is for vital infrastructure, reinforced walls must be used
\t d. If it is for a high-security area, reinforced walls must be used
\t e. Walls must be non-reinforced if unnecessary
## 2. Windows \t a. Windows must either have flooring or a grille below them
\t b. Outermost windows must be reinforced and have grilles below
\t c. If it is for vital infrastructure, reinforced windows and grilles must be used
\t d. If it is for a high-security area reinforced windows and grilles must be used
\t e. If it is for non-public areas grilles must be used but not reinforced windows
\t f. Windows must be un-reinforced and without a grille if unnecessary
## 3. Doors \t a. Room must have a minimum of one entry and exit point
\t b. Doors must be fully functional and have no tampering
\t c. Entries and Exits must be easy to reach
\t d. Doors must be painted to represent the department they are within or provide entry into
\t e. Doors must be access locked to the department they reside in or provide entry into
\t f. Doors must be reinforced if they provide entry into a high-security area
